title: Study of Electrocardiogram (ECG) Safety of Sezaby in Neonatal Seizures
official: A Prospective, Single-Arm, Open-Label Study to Assess the Effect of Sezaby™ on Electrocardiographic Safety in Patients With Neonatal Seizures
summary: This Phase 4, multicenter, single-arm, open-label study evaluates the effect of intravenous Sezaby (phenobarbital sodium) on electrocardiographic safety, including the QT interval, in neonates with seizures.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Neonates with seizures confirmed by continuous electroencephalogram (cEEG) monitoring.
2. Acute symptomatic seizure etiologies other than correctable metabolic abnormalities.
3. Term or preterm infants with postnatal age less than 28 days.
4. Body weight of at least 1 kg.
5. Written informed consent from a parent or legal guardian.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Prior treatment with anticonvulsant medications.
2. Correctable metabolic abnormalities associated with seizure cessation when corrected.
3. Baseline QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) greater than 450 milliseconds.
4. Significant risk factors for torsade de pointes, including congenital long QT syndrome or significant cardiac disease.
5. Renal failure.
6. Acute porphyria.
7. Neonates in whom death is considered imminent in the opinion of the investigator.
